findings.finding: At 9M the company's own numbers put FY2026 at the bottom of both guidance ranges: gross profit >= EUR 280m needs Q4 GP >= EUR 73m, +6% on Q4/25's ~EUR 69m, against +4.5% in Q3 and +5.1% over 9M in a market the company says contracted in Q2-Q3; EBIT low end needs Q4 >= EUR 9.9m vs ~EUR 9.4m a year ago, and the 9M trajectory (+27%) points to ~EUR 41-43m, so any qualifier ('unteres Ende', 'rund 280') on Monday is a modest negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025: ad-hoc cut revenue/GP guide (EBIT kept), stock fell to lowest since Nov 2023 (Boersen-Zeitung); the final Q3/25 report on 10 Nov 2025 then rose ~4.2% with guide held. Aug 2026: guidance confirmed in the H1 report and the stock fell ~3% ('Hypoport bestaetigt Jahresziele fuer 2026 - Aktie gibt nach').
findings.original_quote: Rohertrag: 70 Mio. Euro (Q3/25: 67 Mio. Euro) bzw. 207 Mio. Euro (9M/25: 197 Mio. Euro); EBIT: 10,8 Mio. Euro (Q3/25: 7,6 Mio. Euro) bzw. 30,1 Mio. Euro (9M/25: 23,6 Mio. Euro) -- with no Prognose sentence, against the 2025 analogue 'entscheidet der Vorstand die Jahresprognose 2025 wie folgt anzupassen' (https://www.hypoport.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/20251027-Hypoport-Insiderinformation-gemaess-Artikel-17-MAR-vorlaeufige-Ergebnisse-Q3-2025.pdf). Guide: 'We therefore confirm our guidance of at least EUR 280 million in gross profit and EUR 40-55 million in EBIT' (2026-08-10).
findings.why_not_priced: The ad-hoc gave the quarter but said nothing on the year, and the coverage read it as a beat (EBIT +42%); the stock is +28% in 20 days and +14% on 4-5 Nov, which is not the tape of a market discounting a low-end qualifier. If it were priced the run-up would have stalled after the ad-hoc rather than extending. Cut small because the company did NOT ad-hoc a guidance change (it did in Oct 2025, and MAR would require it for a material change), and because the H1 ad-hoc was equally silent before a plain confirmation, so the likeliest outcome is reiteration.
findings.independence: Company's own market description of contracting Q2-Q3 volumes and Europace +1% (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/hypoport-se-solid-operating-performance-in-a-declining-overall-market/5f31951b-d40b-4727-bb90-09f78f3141d5_en); FY2025 base from https://www.hypoport.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/20260316-PM-Hypoport-GJ-Ergebnisse-2025.pdf. Same underlying arithmetic, not an independent directional signal.
